prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: MINIMALIST MAIN MENU CONCEPT for original fighting game "GALE BREAKER: ELEMENTAL CLASH". Generate ONE finished widescreen 16:9 game menu screen, not a multi-panel sheet and not a monitor photograph. Input image 1 is the mandatory NEW CHARACTER IDENTITY reference; take Kaze exclusively from its first column, discard all old character designs. Kaze is a very tall slender bald adult male monk, jade-green fabric robes, exposed bare feet, upright straight posture, serene calm expression, absolutely no ponytail, no headband, no ninja armor.

PRIMARY DESIGN DIRECTION: radically more minimalist than an ornate fighting game menu. Quiet, restrained, confident, sophisticated. About 60 percent negative space. Clean warm-ivory understated sans-serif text on deep desaturated blue-green atmosphere. Only a tiny jade-green selection dash and one subtle small gold separator are allowed; NO boxed buttons, NO gold picture frames, NO ornamental corners, NO glowing borders, NO skill icons, NO character portrait cards, NO collage of four heroes, NO busy particles or giant auras.

Composition: left 38% is very calm, naturally darkened by atmospheric shading, with a modest-sized elegant logo near upper-left exactly "GALE BREAKER" and a small spaced subtitle "ELEMENTAL CLASH". Do not use giant italic metallic lettering; restrained modern title typography. Underneath in a narrow left-aligned vertical list with spacious intervals, plain-text options exactly "ARCADE", "VERSUS LOCAL", "TREINO", "HABILIDADES", "OPÇÕES", "SAIR". ARCADE in warm ivory with a small jade dash to its left; other options medium gray-green. A tiny footer in lower-left exactly "↑ ↓  NAVEGAR     ENTER  CONFIRMAR". No other body copy, slogans, patches, currencies, online badges or information blocks.

The rest is one continuous calm painted scene: the new bald jade-robed monk Kaze standing upright on the right third, full body including bare feet, comfortably inset from edges, slightly turned toward the open mountain courtyard. He is an atmospheric human-scale presence, not a giant close-up filling the frame. Jade green robes move gently in a breeze. Quiet stone sanctuary, a single distant torii silhouette, misty layered mountains and restrained pink cherry blossoms at the edge, soft dusk teal-blue light and a pale warm sky band. Background is elegant with simple large shapes and subtle depth, muted colors, a handful of distant golden lantern lights. No other foreground characters. Keep the left menu area unobstructed and low-contrast. Artistic medium: polished stylized hand-painted game concept environment with controlled cel-shaded monk, clear readable materials. Achieve emotional calm and visual restraint while retaining elemental martial-arts identity. Original designs only, no watermark.
